verdict.rationale: Orb supports some bulk-like operations — ingesting usage events at scale, backfilling historical events, exporting resource types in bulk, and cursor-based pagination for listing many resources — but there is no explicit bulk API (e.g., bulk subscription edits, bulk invoice issuance, or batch update endpoints) documented for AI-native automation across many items at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-action API endpoints, documentation of batch processing limits, and any AI-agent-specific bulk workflow examples.
